name: Phone media
author: phonelink
description: What the phone is playing, with play/pause, skip and volume

barWidget.description: The track playing on the phone; click to play or pause, right to skip, wheel for volume. Takes no room when nothing is playing.

schema.label: Refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask the phone what is playing. Each check is one short D-Bus call.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is playing
schema.description: Take no room in the bar unless the phone has a player loaded.

schema.label: Track title
schema.description: Show the title beside the glyph, not just the glyph.

schema.label: Title width (pixels)
schema.description: Longer titles are elided, so one song cannot push the rest of the bar along.

schema.label: Volume step
schema.description: How much one notch of the wheel changes the phone's volume.

schema.label: phonelink command
schema.description: Normally just "phonelink". Point this at a checkout to run one that is not installed.
